title: Weight-Based Infusion Rate (peds drips)

changelog.change: Initial entry — generic weight-based infusion formula, drug-agnostic.

purpose: Converts an ordered weight-based dose to a pump rate for any continuous infusion (dopamine, dobutamine, epinephrine, norepinephrine, fentanyl, midazolam …). Enter the bag concentration for the specific drug.

interpretation.label: Rate (mL/h) = dose (mcg/kg/min) × weight (kg) × 60 ÷ concentration (mcg/mL). Double-check the concentration units — mg/mL must be converted to mcg/mL (× 1000).

notes: For a dose ordered in mcg/kg/h or units/kg/h, adjust the ×60 factor accordingly. This is the single reusable engine behind every weight-based drip — a production build should add a per-drug concentration picker on top.
